function.name: check_availability
function.description: Get the next available appointment slots at the clinic. Always call this before offering any time to the caller. Pass a preference when the caller has stated a time of day, and an urgency you inferred from their symptoms.

count.description: How many slots to fetch. Default 3.

preference.description: Filter by time of day. morning = 9am-12pm, afternoon = 12pm-5pm, evening = 5pm-8pm. Use 'any' or omit if the caller has not stated a preference.

urgency.description: How soon they need to be seen. 'urgent' = fever/pain/infection, needs earliest available slot. 'normal' = persistent but stable symptoms, next few days. 'routine' = check-up or non-symptomatic, 2+ days out is fine. Default 'normal'.

function.name: request_callback
function.description: Log a callback request when you cannot help the caller book (they need medical advice, want a refund, ask about something outside appointments, or the conversation is getting stuck). Confirms with a friendly line then the call ends. Do NOT use if the caller is actively trying to book an appointment.

patientName.description: Caller's name if they gave it. Optional.

patientPhone.description: 10-digit Indian phone number to call back on.

reason.description: One short line: what the caller needed (e.g. 'wants refund', 'medical advice about diabetes', 'confused about the flow').

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book a specific slot for a patient. Only call after confirming slot, name, and phone number. Pass the same urgency you decided from their symptoms.

slotISO.description: The ISO timestamp of the slot, exactly as returned by check_availability.

reason.description: One short line on why they are coming in — their symptoms in their own words.

urgency.description: Same value passed to check_availability. Defaults to 'normal'.
